questions.text: Elucidate the psychosocial development in infancy.
Describe the motor development that takes place during mid-childhood.
Examine information processing approach to cognitive development during adolescence.
Discuss the various challenges during the adolescence stage.
Examine the role of peer group on social development during school years.
Elucidate the cognitive changes during middle adulthood.
Discuss the psychosocial changes during early adulthood with reference to Levinson's seasons of life theory.
Briefly discuss the psychosocial changes during old age.
Describe the common emotional patterns during the early school years.
Obstacles in studying life span development
